lastUserInput: Hook test in a throwaway repo. Do each step as a separate tool call and keep going if one fails. Then stop. 1. Use your file write tool, not the terminal, to overwrite app.txt with the word overwritten. 2. Use your terminal tool to run pwd with the tool's working directory set to the sub folder, not using cd. 3. Use your terminal tool to run exactly: sh -c 'sleep 8; exit 4'  and wait for it to finish.
